subject: Check in online before you arrive, Klara - two minutes
body:
Hi Klara,

You're booked into a Classic Double for 2 nights, arriving 4 September (ref MH-3010).

Skip the desk when you get here: tap the link below, photograph your ID, sign the registration card and settle the balance (EUR 183, including city tax). It takes about two minutes, and you walk straight in.

We drafted this in English because German is not yet one of the languages we reply in - a person will check it before it goes out.

Here is your link: https://checkin.example.com/MH-3010

The Hotel Aurora team

This message was prepared with AI assistance and reviewed by our team before it was sent. Reply any time to reach a person directly.
